title: Kamara
body:
You're late and I'm waiting,
on the bench I'm looking at the arch.
I see anxiety spread everywhere,
some gentlemen are talking about the metro.

And everyone is going, going somewhere;
to everywhere and to nothing and returning back.
Pigeons flying,
where could the hope be that they're searching to find?

I'm waiting and breathing
the minutes that away from you I'll have to live.
And I keep going, but where am I going?
I've left but again here I'll return
to wait for you.

Hurried drivers are waiting for the traffic light;
Navarinou is filling up with people.
Two boys manage to catch a kiss,
before the exhaust fumes smell like mint.

And everyone is going, going somewhere...
